sourceNotes.supports: Captions synchronize speech and meaningful non-speech audio with the video; automatic captions require accuracy confirmation.
Basic transcripts convey audio information; descriptive transcripts also convey important visual information and may need additions beyond a caption export.
Description conveys essential visual information, including meaningful screen text; integrated description can be included in main narration.
